title: Validator Trend and Regression Analytics
goal: Add longitudinal validator analytics so governance health can be compared across validation runs, enabling runtime regression detection, stage-duration tracking, warning-count deltas, and SSOT growth monitoring.

problem_statement.current_state: PATCH_DB_GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME_019 introduced staged validation, partial modes, profiling, and richer reports.
problem_statement.remaining_gap: Each validation report is still primarily point-in-time. The runtime does not yet analyze whether governance health, validator duration, registry size, warning counts, or stage costs are improving or regressing over time.
problem_statement.risk: Slow validator degradation, registry drift, warning growth, or patch-chain expansion may remain invisible until they cause a hard failure.

basis.scope: Add compact validation history logging and trend analytics without changing validation semantics, RT_core, or authority-bearing patch decisions.

required_repo_changes.description: Add longitudinal history logging, baseline selection, trend comparison, and compact regression analytics without changing default validator semantics.
Document the history and trend flags, output files, baseline selection behavior, and the claim that trend telemetry does not alter validation outcomes.

acceptance_criteria: python scripts/global_validate.py --history appends one compact JSONL summary.
python scripts/global_validate.py --trend generates validation_trend_report.json using the most recent passing full run by default.
Trend analytics do not alter semantic validation outcomes.
History records remain compact and exclude recursive evidence trees.

warnings: Trend telemetry is additive and does not alter RT_core.
History and trend outputs are audit artifacts, not authority surfaces.
